title: Chapter 126 Collecting Protection Fees From Wana Village
content:
Chapter 126 Collecting Protection Fees From Wana Village

Secondly, the attributes, plus the bonuses from the equipment, are simply terrifying.

Among them, the fat man with the highest level has the highest strength attribute, which is only 15 points.

Wang Shuo is four or five times his strength.

Wang Shuo seemed to hear the sound of swallowing.

Now they finally believed what Wang Shuo said.

Wang Shuo handed these people over to Duan Wenxi, who was responsible for the matters related to the new people joining the village.

Wang Shuo couldn't do everything by himself.

Back in the tent, Wang Shuo began to study the "City Wall Construction Manual".

A book with a dark brown sheepskin cover. After opening it, there are more than ten pages inside.

On the first page, there is a picture of a brick kiln, with a rough introduction to the steps for firing Black Iron City bricks.

On the second page, the materials required for each step are introduced in detail.

…

On the last page, there is the final step of drawing defensive runes.

Of course, you don't need to draw the runes, but the durability is only 5000.

After drawing the defensive runes, a single city brick has a durability of 10,000 and a defense power of 200.

If the attack power does not exceed this value, the defense will not be broken at all.

Moreover, the defensive runes on each city wall brick can be connected to each other, eventually forming an overall defense system.

This is the real black iron city wall.

Wang Shuo watched it for a long time. Although he understood the method introduced above, he had no idea what to do.

Just when he was at his wits' end, the system prompt sounded.

"Black iron level city wall brick production technology, understanding 1%."

"What?" Wang Shuo showed a surprised expression, "You can actually understand the production technology of city wall bricks through observation?"

In this way, Wang Shuo was greatly relieved and finally found a way.

This is like practicing a skill, which requires continuous improvement of proficiency.

In this case, Wang Shuo began to understand with his heart.

After a few more hours, Wang Shuo's comprehension progress reached 80%.

The reason why Wang Shuo slowly understood it on his own was not that he didn't want to use the "Skill Proficiency Manual" he had obtained before, but that this manual could only improve proficiency and could not replace comprehension.

Besides, Wang Shuo likes his life and career very much and is willing to think about it slowly.

At this time, there was a noise outside.

Wang Shuo stopped comprehending and walked out of the tent.

In the distance, a group of men with big swords and fierce faces were shouting at their subjects.

Wang Shuo suddenly became furious, walked over quickly, and used the "Eye of Deception" to investigate.

You won’t know if you don’t look at it, but you will be shocked when you look at it.

It was actually five bandits.

Their levels are basically around level 20.

The leader is a small bandit leader, level 22.

Wang Shuo was delighted.

I saw a bandit pushing a citizen down and threatening loudly: "Call your lord out quickly, tell me that Wadang Mountain and Qingmuzhai are here to collect the filial piety fee."

Seeing how rampant the bandits were, the nearby residents gnashed their teeth and faced the bandits with gloomy expressions.

Due to the huge difference in levels, the citizens did not dare to take action.

A leader ran over quickly and wanted to inform Wang Shuo, but he happened to meet Wang Shuo rushing over.

"Lord, no luck, there are bandits coming!"

Wang Shuo nodded and hurried over.

At this time, Gong Zheng, Li Jianguo and others also gathered around one after another.

"Are you bandits from Wadang Mountain?" A strange smile appeared on Wang Shuo's lips, but he didn't break out immediately.

"Boy, are you looking for death? Although we are bandits, you can't call us like that. You have to call us heroes."

Wang Shuo smiled and sighed to himself, these bandits are quite intelligent, I don't know if they are tools or players.

"Okay, let me ask you, what is the name of your village leader? How many brothers are there in the village?" Wang Shuo asked with a calm face, trying to trick him.

"Our leader is the famous Decepticon Zhang Wenlong. How about it? Don't be afraid!" The bandit leader was a little proud. When he mentioned their boss, an inexplicable sense of pride arose spontaneously.

"I'm afraid, I'm afraid! I don't know how many brothers you have." Wang Shuo asked immediately.

"What do you want to do? I'm telling you, don't ask about our cottage." The bandit leader frowned and became wary.

"Brother, it's like this. Only after knowing your number can I know how much filial piety I should pay, right?"

"Stop talking nonsense, we charge protection fees based on the number of people in the village."

"You only need to turn in 300 gold coins this month, and that's it."
